Relevance AI's listed product is Relevance AI, categorized under coding & developer tools, with no-code AI workforce as the function this data names first.

The data also tags Relevance AI with agent teams, task automation, and APAC data residency, description of what the product does rather than how well it does it.

Beyond the category, the product name, and this short list of tags tied to relevanceai.com, the data carries no user counts, revenue, funding, or headcount, so nothing here supports a claim about Relevance AI's scale or trajectory.

profile_text.body:
Relevance AI is a platform for building and running AI agents, according to its website. The company says its specialist agents can be built for sales, customer success, marketing and HR, and that customers can run millions of daily tasks on one platform. It also describes an embedded deployment team that gets customers live and then trains their teams to build on their own, and a product called Invent that it says lets non-technical teams stand up their own AI workforces in hours. The site says users can scope, prioritize and build use cases independently, including what it calls Level 3 and Level 4 autonomous agent workforces.

The site quotes Rob Giglio on looking for places where AI can let sellers and customer success representatives be more engaged with customers, and it references a fireside session with Confluent's Applied AI leaders on agents that run autonomously in production.

In this site's records, Relevance AI is tracked as a product in the Coding and Developer Tools category, described as a no-code AI workforce with agent teams, task automation and APAC data residency. No lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company.
